brief:
Large numbers of Israeli military helicopters were observed over several areas of the West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The aircraft movements occurred as Israel transferred a helicopter squadron from Ramon Air Base to Ramat David Air Base.

The helicopter transfer marks a significant repositioning of Israeli air assets. Such movements across Palestinian airspace are a routine but closely monitored aspect of military operations in the region.
